enunciado: Sort {12, 11, 13, 5, 6, 7} with insertion sort: take each element (the key) and shift the larger ones to the right until its place is found. Show the key and the array after inserting it.
objetivos: Relate it to sorting cards in your hand
pistas: Save the key before shifting: it will be overwritten.
Shift while j >= 0 and a[j] > key.
